question: Will the temperature in NYC hit 19°C on Oct 15, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if at least one recorded temperature observation at the New York City Central Park station (KNYC) reaches or exceeds 19°C (66.2°F) strictly after 2026-10-15T04:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-16T04:00:00Z.
- "No": Wins if no recorded temperature observation at the New York City Central Park station (KNYC) reaches or exceeds 19°C (66.2°F) during that same interval.

Clarifications:
- Temperature is taken from official hourly surface observations reported for KNYC (New York City, Central Park). Any credible weather data provider reporting those same KNYC observations may be used.
